secondary.title: The Gutenberg Revolution
secondary.author: John Man
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and accessible account of Gutenberg's life and the impact of his invention, drawing on extensive research.

secondary.title: Gutenberg and the Printing Press
secondary.author: Rebecca Stefoff
secondary.rationale: Part of the 'Inventions That Changed the World' series, this book provides a good overview of Gutenberg's work and its historical context.

secondary.title: The Gutenberg Bible: Landmark of the West
secondary.author: David McKitterick
secondary.rationale: Focuses specifically on the most famous product of Gutenberg's press, offering detailed historical and bibliographical analysis.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources directly authored by Johannes Gutenberg are extremely rare or non-existent in accessible digital archives. His work is primarily known through the artifacts he produced, such as the Gutenberg Bible, and contemporary or near-contemporary accounts of his life and business dealings, which are not typically available as standalone texts by him.
